ROW.COLUMN: (ML/EN) High Risk Transactions - High Risk Counter Party

Financial institutions apply enhanced scrutiny to transactions involving geographies and entities (including other financial institutions) that are considered as high risk. Transactions involving high-risk geographies and entities generate increased exposure to money laundering and other types of fraud. Mantas utilizes external and internal watch lists (provided by the client) to identify high-risk geographies and entities. For examples, FATF-designated countries; INCSR-designated major Money Laundering countries; entities or sanctioned countries appearing on OFAC lists; internal lists that the institution maintains. This scenario generates alerts on firm accounts, customers, household, correspondent banks, and external entities engaging in high risk transactions based on the risk of the counter parties, geographies, and products involved in the transactions.

The main objective of this pattern is to find focal entities with its transaction activity risk level greater or equal to the scenario risk threshold value of High-Risk Level or Very High-Risk Level and which total amount values of all kind of transactions with High-Risk level is grater or equal then the threshold value of Min Total Very High-Risk or High-Risk .Amount.
The exact transactional amount values for each type of transaction (wire, cash, MI) per each focal entity are calculated in the respective sub-rule.
Final assessment is done in the check-point where amount values of all kind of transactions are compared with threshold values and alert generation is done.
The objective of main rule is to create dataset populated with focal entities checked with scenario parameters having at least one transaction (wire, cash, MI) also checked with scenario parameters during the frequency period.
The objective of the first sub-rule is to select all wire transactions data of the focal entity during the Look-Back Period. Total amount values are calculated and store in appropriate bind variable. Additional aggregated and score binding attributes of transactions are selected.
The objective of the second sub-rule is to select all MI transactions of the focal entity during the Look-Back Period.. Total amount values are calculated and stored in the appropriate bind variable. Additional aggregated and score binding attributes of transactions are selected.
The objective of the third sub-rule is to select all cash transactions of the focal entity during the Look-Back Period. Total amount values are calculated and store in appropriate bind variable. Additional aggregated and score binding attributes of transactions are selected.
The objective of the first check-point is to summarize amount values of all kind of transactions and weed out all focal entity that fail to check with alert generation parameters.
